text:
<|ifm|begin_of_text|><|ifm|im_start|>system
# Tools
You may call one or more tools to assist with the user query.

Available tools are:

<ifm|tools>
## create_event
Create a calendar event with "quotes", a back\slash and unicode: café ☕.

**Parameters**
- `title` *(string, required)*
  - title: Title
  - examples: ['Standup', '1:1']
- `attendees` *(array of Person, required)* - Who comes.
  At least one.
  - Items *(Person)*
    - Description: A person
    - `name` *(string, required)*
    - `email` *(string)*
      - format: email
- `organizer` *(Person)* - Overrides the def description
  - $ref: #/$defs/Person
- `color` *(string)*
  - Allowed values: `red`, `it's green`, `blue\ish`
  - Default: `red`
- `duration` *(anyOf[integer or string])*
  - anyOf:
    - Variant 1 *(integer)*
    - Variant 2 *(string)*
      - pattern: ^[0-9]+m$
- `when` *(oneOf[string or null])*
  - oneOf:
    - Variant 1 *(string)*
      - format: date-time
    - Variant 2 *(null)*
- `priority` *(integer or null)*
  - Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `None`
  - Default: `None`
- `ratio` *(number)*
  - Default: `0.1`
  - minimum: 1e-05
  - maximum: 1e+16
- `weight` *(number)*
  - Default: `2.0`
- `flags` *(object)*
  - Default: `{'a': True, 'b': False}`
  - Additional properties *(boolean)*
- `meta` *(object)*
  - Additional properties: False
  - Pattern properties:
    - `^x-` *(string)*
- `tags` *(array of string)*
  - Default: `[]`
  - Items *(string)*
  - maxItems: 10
- `note` *(string)*
  - Default: ""
- `big` *(integer)*
  - Default: `12345678901234`

**Returns**
- Return *(object)*
  - `id` *(string)* - Event id

## now

**Parameters**
- None

## lookup
Look up.

**Parameters**
- `key` *(string)*

**Returns**
- Return *(string)*

## pick

**Parameters**
- oneOf:
  - Variant 1 *(object)*
    - `a` *(string)*
  - Variant 2 *(object)*
    - `b` *(integer)*

## bare_fn
A tool without the function wrapper.

**Parameters**
- `x` *(number)*
</ifm|tools>

When calling tools, you MUST follow the tool-call format below:

Wrap all tool calls in a single <ifm|tool_calls></ifm|tool_calls> block. For each call, write the function name at the start of <ifm|tool_call>, followed by paired <ifm|arg_key> and <ifm|arg_value> tags for each argument:

<ifm|tool_calls>
<ifm|tool_call>$FUNCTION_NAME
<ifm|arg_key>$PARAMETER_NAME</ifm|arg_key>
<ifm|arg_value>$PARAMETER_VALUE</ifm|arg_value>
...
</ifm|tool_call>
</ifm|tool_calls>

String and scalar parameters should be written as plain text. Array and object parameters should be written as JSON literals.<|ifm|im_end|><|ifm|im_start|>user

## create_event
Create a calendar event with "quotes", a back\slash and unicode: café ☕.

**Parameters**
- `title` *(string, required)*

  - examples: ['Standup', '1:1']
- `attendees` *(array of Person, required)* - Who comes.

    - `email` *(string)*
      - format: email
- `organizer` *(Person)* - Overrides the def description
  - $ref: #/$defs/Person
- `color` *(string)*
  - Allowed values: `red`, `it's green`, `blue\ish`
  - Default: `red`
- `duration` *(anyOf[integer or string])*
  - anyOf:
    - Variant 1 *(integer)*
    - Variant 2 *(string)*
      - pattern: ^[0-9]+m$
- `when` *(oneOf[string or null])*
  - oneOf:
    - Variant 1 *(string)*
      - format: date-time
    - Variant 2 *(null)*
- `priority` *(integer or null)*
  - Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `None`
  - Default: `None`
- `ratio` *(number)*
  - Default: `0.1`
  - minimum: 1e-05
  - maximum: 1e+16
- `weight` *(number)*
  - Default: `2.0`
- `flags` *(object)*
  - Default: `{'a': True, 'b': False}`
  - Additional properties *(boolean)*
- `meta` *(object)*
  - Additional properties: False
  - Pattern properties:
    - `^x-` *(string)*
- `tags` *(array of string)*
  - Default: `[]`
  - Items *(string)*
  - maxItems: 10
- `note` *(string)*
  - Default: ""
- `big` *(integer)*
  - Default: `12345678901234`

**Returns**
- Return *(object)*
  - `id` *(string)* - Event id
